voices.name: l00
voices.text: When you start waking up as your true self, <#0.2#> do you know who stops you first?
voices.caption: When you start waking up as your true self, do you know who stops you first?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Not strangers. <#0.3#> Your family, your friends, the people you love.
voices.caption: Not strangers. Your family, your friends, the people you love.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: What's gotten into you? <#0.2#> Be realistic. <#0.2#> Go back to the old you.
voices.caption: What's gotten into you? Be realistic. Go back to the old you.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Like Agent Smith in The Matrix, <#0.2#> anyone still inside the game can play that role.
voices.caption: Like Agent Smith in The Matrix, anyone still inside the game can play that role.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: They're not your enemy. <#0.2#> The rules of the game are just speaking through them.
voices.caption: They're not your enemy. The rules of the game are just speaking through them.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Keep the love. <#0.3#> But don't fall back asleep.
voices.caption: Keep the love. But don't fall back asleep.
